## Checklist (tool PRs: see docs/TESTING_PROTOCOL.md)

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
- [ ] `npm run test` and `npm run check` pass
- [ ] `npm run build` and `npm --prefix site run test:e2e` pass
- [ ] Every input has `help` text; ≥ 1 example with golden `expected` values
- [ ] README has Overview / How to use / Method / Limitations / References
- [ ] CITATION.cff and tool CHANGELOG.md updated; `version` and `maintenance.updated` bumped
- [ ] CHANGELOG.agent.log appended (never edited)
- [ ] No ads inside the tool frame; no new colours outside tokens
